column2: description

Soil organic carbon measured by dry combustion elemental analysis (CNS analyzer), 0-30 cm depth. Samples collected annually at end of growing season. Results expressed as Mg C ha-1 using measured bulk density for stock calculations.
Bulk density measured from undisturbed soil cores, 0-30 cm depth. Core volume calculated from ring dimensions; dry weight after oven-drying at 105°C.

Soil organic matter fractionation by density separation into particulate organic matter (POM, <1.85 g cm-3) and mineral-associated organic matter (MAOM, >1.85 g cm-3). C and N content of each fraction measured by elemental analysis.
Soil organic matter estimated by loss-on-ignition (LOI): sample ignited at 360°C for 2 hours; organic matter = mass lost as percentage of dry soil mass.
Soil pH measured in 1:1 soil-to-water suspension using a calibrated pH meter.
Soil texture (% sand, silt, clay) determined by the hydrometer method (Bouyoucos 1962). Samples pre-treated with sodium hexametaphosphate dispersant.
Water holding capacity determined by pressure plate apparatus at -0.033 MPa (field capacity). Results expressed as % gravimetric water content.
Substrate-induced respiration (SIR): CO2 released per unit soil mass per hour following addition of glucose substrate. Proxy for active microbial biomass.
Permanganate oxidizable carbon (KMnO4 oxidation), 0-6.7 cm depth
Permanganate oxidizable carbon (KMnO4 oxidation), 0-30 cm depth

Carbon inputs estimated from above-ground biomass harvests (shoot dry weight × C fraction) plus root and exudate estimates using literature root:shoot ratios. Expressed as cumulative total over 8-year study.
Total nitrogen input calculated as sum of: biological N fixation (estimated from legume cover crop biomass × fixation fraction), compost N, and inorganic fertilizer N. Cumulative over 8 years.

Total carbon input calculated from vegetable post-harvest residue dry matter × C fraction (0.368) + cover crop shoot dry matter × C fraction (0.441) + compost dry matter × C fraction (0.317). Cumulative over 8 years.

Nitrogen inputs estimated from cover crop biomass N content, legume N fixation (shoot N × fixation fraction), vegetable residue N, and crop N uptake from tissue analysis. Expressed as cumulative total over 8-year study.
Crop yield measured as fresh weight at commercial harvest. Lettuce: head weight. Broccoli: floret head weight. Cumulative over all crops in study period.

Closed static chamber (3.5 L PVC, 20 cm diam). Gas sampled at t=0,10,20 min; N2O by GC-ECD (Shimadzu GC-2014). Flux upscaled across 3 collar zones (0, 50, 150 cm from emitter) using Baram et al. 2018.
Soil nitrate nitrogen measured by colorimetric method (cadmium reduction or similar), 0-30 cm depth. Samples collected annually at end of growing season.
Total C and N by dry combustion on ground soil; elemental analyzer.
Bulk density by intact soil core (known volume), dried at 105 deg C.
Soil organic matter by Walkley-Black wet oxidation.
Extractable NH4-N and NO3-N by 2M KCl extraction; colorimetric quantification.
In-field crop yield from hand-harvested subsamples or machine harvest as noted.
Extractable NH4-N and NO3-N determined colorimetrically following the Keeney and Nelson method; applied to KCl extracts.
Extractable NH4-N and NO3-N determined colorimetrically following the Doane and Miranda method; applied to KCl extracts.
